adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` within the updated `updateAllCalendarEvents` loop, when a calendar `reference.credentialId` is not found in `this.calendarCredentials`, the code now falls back to `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: reference.credentialId } })` and then uses that credential for `updateEvent(...)` without verifying it belongs to the booking’s organizer/host/user/team. Previously, a missing credential in `this.calendarCredentials` would effectively prevent using an out-of-scope credential; the new DB fallback broadens the set of credentials that can be used, creating a real authorization/security risk if a booking reference contains an unexpected credentialId.
